subject: Retention cutover & SLA exception request for tenant purge window
messages:
From: Grace Liu <grace.liu@novara-payments.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Cc: security-team@novara-payments.com
Date: Fri, 29 Nov 2029 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API retention — proposed cutover window and SLA exception

Hi Tessa,

Quick question as we prepare our compliance deck: Novara intends to finalize a tenant-level purge of historical test data on 2029-12-07. Our legal and security teams are asking whether Redwood can perform a coordinated cutover that would: 1) schedule a tenant purge in the Hosted API window, 2) temporarily relax the 24-hour latency SLA for purges to a 72-hour window for that tenant only, and 3) provide an attestation of completed deletion and backup sweep.

Can you confirm if Redwood can operationalize a one-off SLA exception for Novara's tenant? Also, what evidence artifacts do you provide post-purge (audit log export, snapshot IDs, retention matrix mapping)?

Thanks — Grace
Grace Liu
Security Lead, Novara Payments

----

Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 29 Nov 2029 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API retention — proposed cutover window and SLA exception

Hi Grace — thanks for the clear ask. Short answer: we can support a coordinated tenant purge and produce the standard evidence bundle, but we need a small ops/engineering runbook and an approved SLA deviation before we commit to the exact timing.

What we can provide for the cutover:
- A scheduled purge job scoped to the Novara tenant which will remove tenant-scoped metadata and message content from the hosted API persistent store.
- An extended purge SLA window (one-off) of up to 72 hours, documented in an internal exception and visible on the purge run ticket.
- Evidence artifacts after completion: audit log export (JSON lines), snapshot IDs (if any snapshots were taken for rollback), retention_matrix_v2.xlsx mapping fields to retention buckets, and a signed attestation PDF.

I'll loop in our security engineering lead (Jonas) and retention ops (Neha) on details and an ops playbook. Can you confirm Novara's preferred cutover date(s) and any blackout windows? If Dec 7 is still the target, we'll start the approval flow Monday and propose a 12:00–18:00 UTC cutover window (to minimize overlap with your US peak).

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Operational checklist (draft):
1) Runbook: retention_cutover_playbook.pdf — includes pre-checks, rollback steps, and verification queries.
2) Pre-cutover snapshot: take metadata snapshot (immutable) and store snapshot ID in ticket. Snapshot retained for 30 days for rollback only.
3) Purge job: tenant-scoped, idempotent, and failsafe (mark-and-sweep across index shards).
4) Audit evidence: produce audit export (start/end times, operator id, job id, deleted object count) and retention_matrix_v2.xlsx mapping.
5) Post-purge verification: small sampling query, signed attestation PDF, and a downloadable log bundle.

Questions for GRC approval doc: who signs the attestation from Redwood (ops manager or security lead)? I propose signed-by: Jonas Weber, Security Engineering.

Let me know if we need a tighter cutover window than Tessa suggested. Also, confirm whether Dec 7 (UTC noon) is locked — Grace, please confirm.

-Jonas

Hi Grace — thanks for confirming availability. Novara has confirmed Dec 7 is acceptable. We've completed the internal exception request and the GRC signoff flow is now in progress. Next steps and deliverables: 

1) Approved one-off SLA exception (72-hour purge window) — internal exception ID: EXC-2029-1129-07.
2) Schedule: purge job will be kicked at 2029-12-07T12:00:00Z; job expected to finish within 72 hours absolute.
3) Evidence bundle delivered to Novara within 48 hours of job completion: audit_logs.jsonl, retention_matrix_v2.xlsx, signed-attestation.pdf, and optional snapshot manifest.
4) DocuSign: we will send a short SLA deviation amendment for signature (DocuSign link included).

Attachments included in this thread: retention_cutover_playbook.pdf — operational steps; retention_matrix_v2.xlsx — mapping; docusign-lodgement-link.url — link to amendment.

If you want the attestation signed by our Security Engineering manager, we'll have Jonas sign. Please reply to confirm the signatory name for the attestation and whether Novara needs any extra fields in the audit export (e.g., dataset hashes).

Thanks — we aim to make this low friction.

Best regards,
